local-worker-controls.registeredOnThisCo: Registered on this computer; not started yet.
local-worker-controls.startingWaitingFor: Starting; waiting for the server to accept this Worker. A previous connection lease can delay readiness.
local-worker-controls.workerControllerRu: Worker controller running. Server connectivity and harness readiness are shown separately below.
local-worker-controls.stopIntentSavedWai: Stop intent saved; waiting for the original Worker controller to exit.
local-worker-controls.workerControllerEx: Worker controller exited. Existing session cleanup and recovery remain separate.
local-worker-controls.workerExitIsUnconf: Worker exit is unconfirmed. Inspect its private log and original session recovery before explicitly replacing the controller.
local-worker-controls.registrationIsSepa: Registration is separate from startup. The Worker continues after you quit DeliDev. Harnesses must already be installed.
local-worker-controls.stoppingThisWorker: Stopping this Worker interrupts its active work and prevents this controller from reconnecting. Sessions remain saved and may require recovery.
local-worker-controls.theWorkerGeneratio: The Worker generation changed. Refresh and select its current generation before a new stop.
local-worker-controls.theRetainedStopTar: The retained stop targets only its original generation.
